summary: All 64 pieces pass. In every probe the cut tops sit exactly on the native lip for rise 1-4, feet meet the road, and the side walls continue the native face colours (sand strata, snow-capped stone, peat logs with grass rim, cave rock). Stairs read clearly as steps at 1x; ramps read as recessed light wedges with shaded walls like the grass reference. Minors: ramp floors taper to ~half road width at the foot, chevron texture reads a bit like a gully, thin/vanishing right walls on some h3-h4 w3 ramps, snow tread noise looks like lettering, cave stairs are masonry vs cobble face.
